reports.title: Hinge Health reports record third quarter 2026 financial results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: We are providing the following guidance for our fourth quarter 2026 and full year 2026:

•Q4 2026: We expect revenue to be between $249 million and $251 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 46% at the midpoint. We expect non-GAAP income from operations to be between $81 million and $83 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 71% and non-GAAP operating margin of 33% at the midpoint, a ~470 bps increase over Q4 2025.

•Full Year 2026: We are raising our revenue guidance to be between $879 million and $881 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 50% at the midpoint. We are raising our non-GAAP income from operations guidance to be between $266 million and $268 million, reflecting year-over-year growth of 123% and non-GAAP operating margin of 30% at the midpoint, a ~1,000 bps increase over 2025.
